subject: Cartistry renewal & commit upgrade — ops handoff
messages:
From: Alex Murphy <alex@cartistry.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal options — hosted commit increase

Hey Vanessa,

We’re coming up on contract renewal for Cartistry (Nov 1) and want to discuss moving to a higher monthly commit for our hosted API usage. Over the past 3 months we’ve outpaced our current tier and expect another big spike this holiday season.

High-level asks:
- What does a 50% or 75% commit increase look like for pricing and rate limits?
- Can you guarantee a burst pocket for seasonal spikes (Black Friday window)?
- Any needed lead time for switching tiers and expected impact to latency/SLOs?

I’ve looped in procurement (procurement@cartistry.io). If you can send a short set of options and a rough ballpark by EOD Monday that’d be great.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Murphy
Head of Platform
Cartistry
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alex Murphy <alex@cartistry.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal options — hosted commit increase

Alex — thanks for the clear ask. I ran a quick pass with our billing and infra teams; attaching a short usage export to ground the proposals.

Attachment: Usage_Analysis_Q3_Cartistry.csv (token counts by route + 95th pct latency by model)

Three pragmatic pathways we recommend for Nov 1 start date:

1) Conservative bump (+50% commit):
   - Tier: move from S2 -> S3
   - Billing: +50% monthly commit, prorated for Nov
   - Rate limits: nominal per-route increased by 40% (same concurrency rules)
   - Burst pocket: 5% monthly by default, additional seasonal burst by request (ops-approved)
   - Pricing impact: estimated +37% ARR vs current (see cost sheet if you want math)

2) Aggressive bump (+75% commit + seasonal cushion):
   - Tier: S3 with temporary burst lane increase during Nov 15–Dec 5
   - Burst pocket: 15% monthly + one-time seasonal burst (up to 40% aggregate for 10 days)
   - SLA addendum recommended for guaranteed latency under load (we can draft)

3) Annual prepay + price lock (12mo):
   - Commit: choose either option above but pay annually in advance for 15% off list (saves vs monthly billing)
   - Includes a small implementation window for faster onboarding and priority queueing for capacity planning

Next steps I suggest: you confirm which pathway you prefer and whether procurement prefers annual prepay. I’ll loop in Dylan (operations) to prepare the capacity plan and Rishi to confirm margin/discount options.

Quick note on lead time: for a tier move and quiet capacity predictability we need ~3 weeks to align GPU pools and routing policies; for a temporary seasonal burst we can typically approve within 5 business days if we have clear dates and a signed amendment.

Happy to hop on a 30-min call tomorrow if that helps.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Cartistry renewal — quick internal ask

Team — forwarding Cartistry thread. TL;DR: they’re primed for a commit increase and want clear burst guarantees for Black Friday.

Proposed commercial posture from me:
- Offer path (2) as preferred (75% commit + seasonal cushion) with a targeted 12% discount LOI to close before Sep 15.
- If procurement insists on annual prepay, extend to 15% (must be approved by finance).
- Include a capped seasonal burst clause (up to 40% for a fixed 10-day window) rather than open-ended burst credits.

Ops: Dylan, can you confirm we can front-load capacity for Nov 15–Dec 5 with 10-day 40% burst? If not, what alternatives (shorter window, lower %)?

Rishi/Neha: can you advise on margin impact and whether our standard SLA addendum needs adjustment for this account?

Thanks — V

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alex Murphy <alex@cartistry.io>, procurement@cartistry.io
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 16:11:00 -0700
Subject: Cartistry — proposed commit amendment and ops plan

Alex / Cartistry procurement — attaching a formal amendment and a short cost scenario sheet for the three pathways we discussed. I captured the key dates and an ops handoff plan so your team can prepare for onboarding.

Attachments:
- Cartistry_Commit_Amendment_v1.pdf (legal-friendly markup; includes seasonal burst clause and latency SLO placeholder)
- Cost_Scenario_Sheet.xlsx (detailed numbers for +50% and +75% commit options and the annual prepay case)

Proposal summary (preferred):
- Start date: 2027-11-01
- Commit: +75% monthly (S3 tier)
- Pricing: 12% off list for a 12-month term; 15% off if paid annually in advance
- Seasonal burst: up to 40% for a single 10-day window (Nov 20–Nov 29) — requires 5 business days notice to enable
- Ops: Redwood will prioritize capacity planning with Cartistry during the onboarding sprint; estimated 3-week lead time to fully switch routing and cache policies

Signing flow: we’ll route the amendment via DocuSign for signature and provision capacity upon execution. Link below.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/Cartistry/commit-amendment-044
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-2027-CRTS-044

If that aligns, respond with approval and whether procurement prefers annual prepay. If you want different dates for the seasonal window, propose alternatives now — ops needs lead time.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Murphy <alex@cartistry.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cartistry.io
Date: Sun, 5 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cartistry — proposed commit amendment and ops plan

Vanessa — thanks for the clear proposal and the docs. We’re on board with the preferred pathway. A few quick clarifications before signature: 

- We accept +75% commit (S3) starting 2027-11-01 with the 12% discount.
- Please add an explicit latency SLO for our primary inference route (95th pct token-latency < 220ms) into the amendment — Ops needs to be able to escalate if we hit sustained regressions.
- For seasonal burst, Black Friday window Nov 24–Nov 28 would be our target (narrower than your proposed Nov 20–29). Can you confirm ops can support 40% for that 5-day window?
- We’ll take DocuSign for the amendment; procurement will sign once the SLO line is added.

Also, please loop in Customer Success for the onboarding sprint and a runbook for cache priming.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Murphy
Head of Platform, Cartistry
procurement@cartistry.io
